A deep dive into Indian culture and wedding traditions, with practical insights for sales, marketing, planning, and execution.

About this Event

This workshop is for hotel sales, events, operations, and any professionals and vendors who want to better understand South Asian weddings and events.

About the WorkshopWe are excited to announce India 101 and Weddings workshop on November 18th.
Please join Palino Events and Seva Global for India 101: Culture, Weddings & Business, an interactive workshop designed to help hospitality professionals and wedding industry vendors better understand the Indian market and grow their business.
This half-day program will provide practical insights into:
Indian Culture: Business etiquette, social customs, traditions, holidays, and food.Indian Weddings: Wedding ceremonies, multi-day celebrations, client expectations, and successful event execution.Business Development: Sales, marketing, and operational strategies to attract and better serve Indian clients.Whether you work in hotel sales, events, operations, culinary, banquets, or as a wedding industry professional or vendor, this workshop will help you build cultural confidence, strengthen client relationships, and uncover new business opportunities.
